messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "used in addition to a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity"
set: ["used in addition to a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity", "reduce salt in diet", "follow a cholesterol-lowering diet plan", "learn about foods to eat for enough calcium and vitamin D in diet", "your treatment may include a special diet", "applies to people who get enough iodine in their diet", "used in children and adolescents under close medical supervision and at appropriate dosage", "dispose of used autoinjectors, infusors, and cartridges in sharps container", "treatment is started in hospital and increased slowly for cirrhosis", "treatment may include diet", "avoid driving or hazardous activity", "dispose of used pens, needles, and syringes in an approved sharps container", "should not be used in early pregnancy", "follow special diet to help prevent kidney stones", "used with diuretic", "used when needed"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
